english.note: Use this when explicitly referring to a person who has reached adulthood or legal majority.
Use this when emphasizing legal age, adulthood, or an official age category.

examples.english: A person who is eighteen or over counts as an adult.
examples.traditional: 年滿十八歲先算成年人。
